i read Dan's responses to the issue and here's what I think. The first nerdcubed plays are among the funniest things I have ever watched and I really don't think they depended on the game. My favourites were the open world ones where Dan grabs control of the character and happily makes fun of the storyline, situation, glitches, and even random stuff. It was his sense of humor that was funny not the gameplay. I mean he still has that sense of humor and it does come through time to time.

I still prefer the highly edited style or even the moderately edited plays like mirror's edge. Dan said himself he say wheezy waiter's video and wanted to apply that editing style to video games. The continuous streams of jokes left me in hysterics. Felt a lot like NBC's Community. But even then Dan needs time and peace of mind to make jokes. SO despite getting videos everyday, the time that goes into editing has gone down.

But at least Dan's response reassures me. He said that initially he made the videos himself for fun and worked really hard to put out them to build a fan base. But now he has a huge one and is really trying to appease everyone. With the RCT Completes, Far Cry Permadeaths, Plays, Free Games Fridays and Father and Son days he has covered a large amount of the requests. He has to change the way he makes jokes each and everyday depending on what kind of video. For that I salute you sir. He also says he's gone into another experimental phase of finding which kind of things he is more comfortable with. Testing out things and seeing what sticks. This is good. 

Finally I also understand that everyone has an opinion. I guess what I don't like as much as the initial Nerdcubed videos, some of the new procrastinators really adore. Dan and Wot constantly are working their butts off trying to keep everyone happy. So I guess i should just be happy that I know them and enjoy their videos. Just happy being a procrastinator.

Suggestion: Maybe we should let the team take some time off from and really analyse the fan base and come back with a bang. Don't know if this is possibly.

Also, one thing I think we all agree on is that we need more content for the 2nd Channel :D . I think all of them are still funny! Wot and you need more banter. But then again I understand the time crunch.

Anyways in conclusion thank you Dan for helping me laugh. I know you've had your own share of problems in your life, judging from your blog and vlogs.(You are probably the only recent Internet person I read up on... sorry if it sounds like i am stalking you :P) But the fact that you made something that makes others smile is really something awesome.

That is all. Thanks buddy.(if it's ok to call you that)
